observations: Three photos show a shipping container with two large machines inside, both partially wrapped in plastic and mounted on wooden pallets.
The machine on the left is blue and beige, with a large beige panel and a vented side. The machine on the right is beige with a control panel featuring buttons and digital displays.
Both machines are in wooden crates or frames, suggesting they are new or for shipping.
The container has a watermark 'MACO MACHINES POSTED ON JUJU' across all photos.
No visible brand or model names on the machines themselves in any photo.
The machines appear to be industrial equipment, possibly components of a pet bottle blowing machine as claimed.
